messages:
Maya (AE): Meridian retail team requested a 7-day technical POC. Key asks: confirm we can run an open 7B chat model (low-latency), give hosted vs dedicated cost estimate for ~150k tokens/day, and return security answers by Monday.
Ravi (SE): we have ember-7b-chat and ember-7b-chat-quant in the catalog. Ember quantized (int8) is supported on the optimized runtime path. Hosted will be fastest to spin up; Dedicated gives better steady-state cost. I'll run a compatibility scan tonight.
Sofia (ML Eng): note on model behaviour: ember-7b-chat-quant keeps KV cache well; expect memory drop ~30% vs fp16. I can run a quick perf run on a p4d-like instance for representative numbers. If they need >2k context we should warn about tokenization edge cases.
Priya (Security): they included a security checklist (PII handling, retention, encryption at rest, key management). We have SOC2 report and KMS/HSM docs. No ISO27001 for hosted. If they insist on ISO, Private deployment or on-prem is the path but timeline ~month.
Ethan (Solutions): recommended POC flow: 1) Hosted sandbox with sample dataset (anonymized) to validate quality, 2) optional Dedicated trial for latency/cost profiling. I'll assemble a one-page packet: steps, timelines, success criteria, and a short pricing summary.
Maya (AE): they prefer Hosted first. Deliverables needed: security one-pager, pricing snapshot for 3 months at 150k tokens/day, and the model compatibility report. Can we get these by EOD Sunday?
Ravi (SE): starting model verify now:
```
ri model verify --model ember-7b-chat --variant ember-7b-chat-quant --checks tokenizer,kv_cache,perf-smoke
```
I'll paste results when complete.
Sofia (ML Eng): quick smoke run results (summary): p50 38ms, p95 95ms @ 10 tokens/req on g5.x; similarity to fp16 baseline ~98.7% on our in-house retail eval set. Memory footprint: ~12GB for quant variant. Will add notes about burst handling.
Priya (Security): can SE attach hosted dataflow diagram and retention policy? I need that for the checklist. Also confirm logs retention defaults for POC.
Ravi (SE): attaching hosted minimal dataflow and default logs retention (30 days). For POC we can shorten to 7 days on request. No persistent KV across sessions by default.
Ethan (Solutions): pricing draft: Hosted gen: $0.001/token retail rate, 25% commit discount -> $0.00075/token. Dedicated example: monthly reserved node $28k, effective token cost ~ $0.00042/token at the commit level (depends on pool utilization). I'll include both in the packet.
Maya (AE): perfect. Please post the scanner output and Sofia's perf table here so I can bundle.
Ravi (SE): scanner summary: tokenizer OK, kv_cache compatible, perf-smoke passed. Full logs uploaded to ticket #5231. No blockers.
Sofia (ML Eng): uploaded perf table + tail latency note. Recommendation: set per-request token cap 64 for stable p95 under burst.
Priya (Security): uploaded security answers, SOC2 link, and a short note on Private deployment as mitigation for ISO queries. Flagged data residency options (EU, US).
Maya (AE): assembling POC packet now and will send to Meridian. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
